# HEIC test images

From the [heic-rs](https://github.com/tbraun96/heic-rs) test fixtures
(MIT OR Apache-2.0): synthetic images encoded with Apple's `sips`, so they
are laid out the way iPhones and Macs write HEIC.

- `rgb-strips-96.heic`: 96×32, red, green and blue 32px vertical strips.
- `checker-1024.heic`: 1024×1024, 64px black/white checkerboard (top-left
  white), stored as a 2×2 grid of 512px tiles like an iPhone photo.
